sources.claim: ILO minimum monthly basic wage for an able seafarer, from 1 January 2027
sources.quote: update the current ILO minimum monthly basic wage for an able seafarer from US$673 to US$690 as of 1 January 2026, US$704 as of 1 January 2027
sources.note: A floor for an able seafarer under a bipartite agreement, not Arjun's wage and not a legal minimum in every flag state.
